d: A desperate suspect flees from the cops after shots are fired, and a father and daughter are caught off-guard when they run into a man wielding a screwdriver.
Officers talk down a knife-wielding man in crisis. A combative overdose call requires a police response. SCORE storms multiple crack houses to shut down neighborhood drug operations.
A vigilant neighbor calls the police when he sees a man robbing a liquor store, and a driver refuses to pull over while driving his new friend's truck.

A desperate driver attempts to flee on foot. Officers investigate a complaint in front of a local convenience store.  Officers coordinate a sting designed to apprehend suspects who patronize prostitutes.
A shooting call at the International Border in El Paso. A man known for huffing gold spray paint upsets his mother. A known prostitute is caught getting a ride.

t: How Many People You Gonna Kill?
d: A fleeing robber causes crashes and t-bones a car during a chase. A transsexual prostitute introduces a deputy to her trick. The NYPD Aviation Unit assists with boaters in distress.

Officers engage in a foot pursuit after the passenger of a suspicious vehicle starts running. A man barricades himself in the house after stabbing his nephew. A teenager is caught ditching school to smoke marijuana.

t: Cops Out of Sight, Out of Mind
d: The K-9 unit tracks down a man fleeing on foot, a father is left with no choice but to call the cops on his son, and a former gang member is found with a stolen firearm.
A man who threatened his neighbors redirects his anger toward the deputies, and a driver in crisis puts the lives of others on the line.
Police have a breakthrough in a burglary case, a man found with drugs in his pants claims the pants are not his, and officers deal with a familiar domestic disturbance call.
Police arrest an uncooperative man with an outstanding warrant, discover marijuana paraphernalia during a traffic stop and investigate a dispute involving a pellet gun.
A domestic call turns chaotic when a male suspect resists and his girlfriend interferes with his arrest. A truck with detachable red and blue lights is located during a call of a police impersonator.
A burglary results in an act of solidarity, a foot pursuit ends when the K-9 unit shows up, and a person with a substance user disorder leaves a strong impression on an officer.
